value.rationale: The Petersen graph is the canonical ten-vertex cubic girth-five distance-regular graph, an independently motivated test case for graph-metric maximal averaging. The exact strong l2 norm and complete equality classification are a natural, non-tabulated invariant; the 3-high/6-mid/1-low symmetry-breaking pattern provides structural information not supplied by generic finite-dimensional spectral reduction. It is a motivated finite complete classification, not an arbitrary slice or an unproved infinite-family extrapolation.
